verdict.rationale:
Vast.ai clearly documents an interruptible/bidding-based instance type advertised as 'often 50%+ cheaper than on-demand' (vast-ai-docs-7/17/22/35/44), satisfying the deep-discount half of the story. However, the evidence never spells out concrete preemption semantics—how bidding actually triggers eviction, notice periods, what happens to running jobs/data on preemption, or SLAs around interruption frequency—so the 'clearly documented preemption semantics' part is only thinly covered.

missing for 10: explicit preemption mechanics (eviction triggers, notice/grace period, checkpoint/restart guidance), and independent confirmation that interruption behavior matches documentation.
